meta.name: poetry-music-visual
meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 把用户给的古诗词解析出意象、情感、手法与文化背景，生成两三组配图场景描述，并输出Suno格式的配乐蓝图（风格标签加结构指令），最后检查图文风格是否一致。
howto.when: 当用户要求为古诗词配图、配乐或制作诗词MV时触发；用户需提供诗词标题、作者或内容。

say.text: 给李白的《静夜思》配一张图和一段纯音乐
say.note: 会先解析诗境，再生成配图描述和Suno配乐蓝图。

say.text: 为王维的《山居秋暝》制作配图方案和配乐风格
say.note: 输出两三组画面方案和风格标签。

say.text: 帮我解析这首词的意象，并给出配乐结构指令
say.note: 适用于你粘贴的任意诗词。

howto.what_en: Analyzes a poem's imagery, emotion, and cultural background; generates 2-3 visual scene descriptions; provides a Suno-format instrumental music blueprint with style tags and structure instructions; checks consistency between image and music.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create an image, add music, or produce a poem MV for a classical poem; the user should supply the poem's title, author, or content.

say_en.text: Illustrate Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thoughts' and create an instrumental piece for it.
say_en.note: It first analyzes the poem, then outputs image scenes and a Suno blueprint.

say_en.text: Create an image plan and music style for Wang Wei's 'Autumn Evening in the Mountains'.
say_en.note: Outputs 2-3 visual concepts and style tags.

say_en.text: Analyze this ci poem's imagery and give me music structure instructions.
say_en.note: Works for any poem you paste.
